title: GI TOWER2 axis=X against job.toml tower2 Y
rationale: Every value both the GI header and job.toml declare must agree; a disagreement is refused at the GI header line, naming both sources and both values (gi-format 10; PHYS-12). Here the GI TOWER2 line says axis X and job.toml tower2 Y; the thickness agrees (t = 17.600, T = 17.6). The project design's case list puts this disagreement and the thickness disagreement in one file; a reader may stop at its first refusal (gi-format 11), so each is its own case (RT27a).
